approach: Independent exhaustive unit-assignment oracle and closed-form 2x2 optimum; no production transport internals reused.

findings.name: 500 seeded exhaustive integer-mass comparisons and permutations
1000 continuous 2x2 problems agree with analytic optimum
Zero and tiny marginal masses remain feasible
Roundoff correction does not create a negative requested fraction
Exact 40% and at-least 40% have distinct intended rankings
Duplicate and reordered nearby targets conserve support
Equidistant target ties do not depend on input order
